section_summary.extract_value: This Results section reports findings from a mixed factorial ANOVA examining state body appreciation (measured via SBAS-2) across high and low acceptance situations, with sex as a between-subjects factor (N≈105). The analysis found a significant main effect for situation (F(1,103)=215.88, p<.001) but no significant main effect for sex or interaction, indicating that the SBAS-2 can detect moment-by-moment changes in body appreciation regardless of sex.
